The '''I5 insulated armor''' was an enhanced form of insulated [[Starship/Legends|starship]] armor. It was produced by the company [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and was available in both single and double insulated forms.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|73|I5,I7}}</ref>
